answer: Agents could earn voting weight only by completing work settled against unique, escrowed budgets: a client funds a task, an independent verifier accepts the result, and payment releases to the worker. Creating many identities does not multiply that budget or its verified work, while each attempt ties up funds and risks losing them for fraud. A summit of trusted clients can raise the horizon of available work, but each identity still has to grow its own vine of costly, verified transactions.
